program:
PARAMS = {
    "I1":    (1.2e-3, 0.6e-3, 1.7e-3),
    "gmid1": (9.0, 6.0, 15.0),
    "L1":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),
    "gmid2": (4.5, 3.0, 7.0),
    "L2":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    I1 = p["I1"]; gmid1 = p["gmid1"]; L1 = p["L1"]; gmid2 = p["gmid2"]; L2 = p["L2"]

    # PMOS diode load: vout = vdd - vsg2
    m2 = lut.size("p", gmid2, L2, I1, vds=0.9)
    vout_dc = vdd - m2.vgs

    # Degenerated NMOS CS: vgs1 + I1*Rs = vcm (iterate for body effect)
    vs = 0.1
    m1 = lut.size("n", gmid1, L1, I1, vds=max(vout_dc - vs, 0.2), vsb=vs)
    for _ in range(6):
        vs = vcm - m1.vgs
        if vs < 0.005:
            vs = 0.005
        m1 = lut.size("n", gmid1, L1, I1, vds=max(vout_dc - vs, 0.2), vsb=vs)
    vs = vcm - m1.vgs
    if vs < 0.005:
        vs = 0.005
    Rs = vs / I1

    mr = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)

    nf1 = max(1, int(round(m1.W / 8.0)))
    nf2 = max(1, int(round(m2.W / 8.0)))

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "vin", "ns", "vss", m1, m=nf1)
    n.R("Rs", "ns", "vss", Rs)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vout", "vdd", "vdd", m2, m=nf2)
    n.dev("Mr", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)

    gm1eff = m1.gm / (1.0 + (m1.gm + m1.gmbs) * Rs)
    rout1 = (1.0 / m1.gds) * (1.0 + (m1.gm + m1.gmbs) * Rs) + Rs
    gl = m2.gm + m2.gds + 1.0 / rout1
    gain = gm1eff / gl
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m1.cgd + m2.cgg + m2.cdd
    f3 = gl / (2 * PI * cout)
    gbw = gain * f3
    power = vdd * (I1 + iref)
    up = vdd - abs(m2.vth) - vout_dc
    down = vout_dc - vs - 0.15
    swing = max(up, 0.0) + max(down, 0.0)

    return n, {"gain_db": db(gain), "f3db": f3, "gbw": gbw, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_dc, "swing": swing}
